scenario: `t.dwell` is a compile-time alias for the time since the fact entered working memory on logical-schema bindings (LSER.10.4, LEXP.9.5.1), independent of series infrastructure: no series declaration is required. Pin: a rule with `where s.dwell > 60_s` on a logical schema with no series compiles. Drives dsc.typecheck lser_10_4_dwell_read, which types dwell as a `Duration`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    state: Float key
    ts: Time

rule stale:
    Sensor s where s.dwell > 60_s
->
    log info "x"
